body.statement: Under the stated four-sample design, \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}d_{\mathrm{BL}}(\mathcal L_P[\sqrt{n/L_n}(\widehat\tau-\tau(P))],N(0,V(P)))\to0\). Uniform map consistency and ass:lift-regularity imply that the half-open-cell lift branch is selected for both \(\widehat p\) and \(\widehat T\) with probability \(1-o(1)\), uniformly over \(\mathcal F_s\); hence the measurable fallback has probability \(o(1)\) and does not alter the limit. This strictly extends the uniform-to-uniform, fixed-source dimension-two conclusion of Proposition 29 in ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT to general variable coefficients and to the four-input nested causal functional.
body.justification: The mixed high-times-low remainder and uniform triangular-array Lindeberg bound establish the full nested fixed-grid limit.
body.gap: Neither fixed-path differentiability nor the fixed-source uniform-law result supplies this shrinking-bandwidth four-input expansion.
body.consumer: It supports inference for prespecified bivariate displacement arrows.
